title: Augmented completion model for an algebra tower
statement: Let $\mathcal A=\operatorname{Mod}(R)$ be the module category of a small ringed site [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], [def-weil-size-convention], with its cochain total tensor [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves] and derived category $Q:\operatorname{CoCh}(\mathcal A)\to D(\mathcal A)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. A tower $B:\mathbb N^{\mathrm{op}}\to\operatorname{CAlg}_R$ [def-weil-inverse-system] gives the strict degree-zero tower $X=B[0]$ augmented by its units $\alpha:R[0]\to X$. A derived inverse-limit datum is a total right-derived functor $L$ of ordinary inverse limit, with universal comparison $\lambda:Q\lim\to LQ$, invertible on K-injective towers, together with the localized evaluation tower and its Milnor homotopy-limit cone [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-strict-tower-homotopy-limit], [lem-pc-homotopy-limit-map]. An augmented completion model is an endofunctor $C_B$ of $D(\mathcal A)$, a natural isomorphism $C_B(QP)\cong LQ(P\otimes X)$ for all K-flat complexes $P$ [def-pc-kflat-complex], and a natural map $\eta:1\to C_B$. Under that comparison, $\eta_{QP}$ is $Q(P\to\lim(P\otimes X))$ followed by $\lambda_{P\otimes X}$, where the first arrow is the compatible family $p\mapsto p\otimes1$. This fixes the whole canonical augmentation, before taking any level projection.
